question.text: Fructose and glucose can be distinguished by:

solution.text: Seliwanoff’s test is used to distinguish between glucose and fructose. Seliwanoff’s reagent (0.5% resorcinol in <math><mn>3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></math> <math><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math> ) gives red solution with fructose but no change in colour with glucose.
